I found no confirmed ship-blocking defect in the D3 slice (08e2dc2 vs a11c63b). I read the code and tests below and did not run anything. The four post-review repairs are present and consistent with the approved D3 contract (PROPOSAL-T5 lines 108-130).

1. Raw-row factor reversal, per-field tamper and collision controls. Reversal is tested at test-sem-branch-map.R:109-114, digit-bearing labels at :116-119, and overlap at :120-121. Tamper of every top-level branch_map field is tested at :40-44. The IDs are length-prefixed and radix-sorted (sem-outcomes.R:28,38). `.sem_valid_outcome` recomputes the map (:213), so forged IDs fail closed.
2. Multifactor boundaries and large-count metadata. `.sem_raw_count` is overflow-safe (sem-outcomes.R:2-12). Tests pin 63/64/65/72, 2^40 and Inf (test-sem-branch-map.R:2-10). Over-cap refusals pin raw_count, enumeration$required and the message for 128, 2^40 and 2000 factors (:77-92). A `.sem_branch_grid` trap plus a zero-fit-call assertion shows nothing is allocated or fitted.
3. Non-first duplicate ties and forwarded args. The tie test (:55-75) has f = 4,1,1,2. Rows 2 and 3 share a canonical ID, and the winner `branch` is pinned to row 2 (`b1 == 0`, `a1 == 0`), so a last-wins or reordered tie would fail. The forwarded args and rhs are asserted in full (:58-59,64).
4. Guarded malformed-map path. `.sem_outcome` wraps the map in tryCatch (sem-outcomes.R:152-154). Test :124-134 shows the original error is retained, the map is "unavailable", the validator rejects it, and the typed condition is preserved.

Propagation, from the code read. `mbco_sem` gates on `.sem_require_outcome` for the full fit (sem-mbco.R:157) and for each refit (:181). It rebases the nested ledgers (:171,203), so branch_map flows through nodes that `.sem_outcome` builds. `.sem_fit_branches` (sem-fit.R:272-357) keeps the raw cap check before the grid, the first-minimum `which.min`, and the existing completeness rule.

Original-obligation map:
- C5 (notices and errors): changed only by the guarded map, which no longer masks the original error. Retained notices in `.sem_abort_outcome` are unchanged.
- 3c: D3 changes the duplicate and 64-branch controls only. Partial-failure ordering, infeasibility exclusion and nested/public propagation are D1/D2 behaviour that D3 left unchanged. I read only the slice of test-sem-outcomes.R at lines 120-180; the fit_sem 64-branch fit (:152-161) does not assert branch_map.
- 3d and items 9-10: unchanged by D3, no D3 evidence. They remain D4/D5 or consumer scope.
- Items 8 and 10: not closed by D3. T5 stays UNACCEPTED.

The owner's 1300 assertions are not independently verified.

findings.title: branch_map not asserted through public fit_sem / mbco_sem paths
findings.body: All D3 tests call `.sem_fit_branches`, `.sem_branch_map` or `.sem_outcome` directly. The one public 64-raw test (test-sem-outcomes.R:152-161) asserts no branch_map field. Nothing pins `fit@diagnostics$outcome$branch_map` on a `fit_sem` result. Nothing tampers `branch_map` on a SEMFit and expects `mbco_sem` to refuse it, and nothing covers the nested mbco refit nodes. The validator does recompute the map (sem-outcomes.R:213), so this is inferred protection, not a demonstrated failure. Also, the tamper loop (test-sem-branch-map.R:40-44) covers only top-level map fields, not child-node maps.
findings.recommendation: Add one public fit_sem case asserting branch_map counts and mapping, and a mbco_sem refusal case with a forged `bad@diagnostics$outcome$branch_map`. Optionally add a child-node map tamper.

findings.title: Large finite raw counts are formatted with %s and may lose precision or switch to scientific notation
findings.body: `.sem_raw_count` returns a double above integer.max, and sem-fit.R:276 formats it with sprintf('%s'). The pinned message is exact only for 2^40. Values around 1e15 or more will print in scientific notation, and values above 2^53 are inexact. The cap decision is unaffected, because anything above 64 refuses, so this is cosmetic or observability only.
findings.recommendation: Use format(count, scientific = FALSE, big.mark = '') for finite doubles, or document the approximate formatting.

next_steps: Optionally add public-path branch_map assertions and a forged-map mbco_sem refusal test.
Run the owner's 1300-assertion suite independently before accepting D3; this review did not execute tests.
Keep T5 UNACCEPTED: D4/D5, 3c nested/public status propagation, 3d and items 8-10 integration, and the real-case evidence remain open.
